plan.title: An 11 pm step inside default quiet hours: no offer or question, a few words that ZOH's texts will still reach them

context.text: Perfect. What time are you usually done eating for the day? That's when you'll send me your log.

transcript.text: I think I should be done eating for the day around 11pm because usually I like to have a late night snack every day
11 pm it is. Logging the snack too keeps the day honest, and I'll still reach you around then. How many minutes a day can you give this for logging and checking your protein? Five, ten?
Five minutes works, since logging in MyFitnessPal is quick. Is there somewhere you want this to get you, like a body goal or a feeling you're after? "Not sure yet" is a fine answer too.
not sure yet, just want to hit it most days

Hitting about 160 g most days is a clear target, and your nightly snack fits right into it. Here's the plan:

• Goal: hit about 160 g of protein most days
• Day 1 is tonight: log everything you ate, snack included, in MyFitnessPal and check your protein total against 160 g
• Time: 11 pm, 5 minutes, every day. I'll text you a heads-up at 10:50 pm.
• Proof: a screenshot of your MyFitnessPal daily summary showing the protein number
• Easy alternative: a voice note telling me your total and how close you got
• Why: seeing the number every night shows you what to adjust the next day

Each day shapes the next step. If you're short on protein, we'll work on where to fit it in. What do you think?
Glad it feels right, Yanni. Tonight at 11 pm is day 1. Are you officially committing to this, every night, snack and all?
LET'S GO, Yanni! 💪 Day 1 is tonight at 11 pm: log everything, snack included, and send me that protein screenshot.

grade.summary: ZOH avoided the quiet-hours regression: it reassured about reaching the tester at 11 without asking to move hours, asked for the time commitment before the plan, showed a concrete • list with the MyFitnessPal screenshot proof, and locked on a clear 'I'm in' with a day 1 hype line.
